snippet.title: Skinwalker - World Premiere Reveal Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2025 Showcase
snippet.description: Skinwalker is a hack n’ slash action platformer where you swear allegiance to a formidable beast to save your daughter from a terminal illness. Shapeshift into the creature’s monstrous form and wield untamed wrath in exchange for its freedom and the promise of a cure. Coming to PC and consoles in 2026.
